CATEGORY
Description
iRules commands and events relating to URL Categorization
Command List
CATEGORY::analytics
- enables or
disables the analytics server on a per request basis
CATEGORY::filetype
- checks for the
mime type and mime subtype of an HTTP request payload
CATEGORY::matchtype
- stores the
match result in the specified variable
CATEGORY::result
- Returns a list of
categories or safe search parameters
CATEGORY::safesearch
- checks for
safe search parameters for the given URL
CATEGORY::lookup
- returns the category
of the supplied URL
Event List
CATEGORY_MATCHED
- triggered when a
custom category match (or prefix match) is found
